# Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison

## Overview
Four datasets capture different dimensions of water stress for 10 countries spanning arid, semi-arid, and water-rich regions. Together they enable a composite view of regional water crisis severity.

## Data Source

### water_supply_demand
Fields: `country` (string), `iso` (ISO 3166 alpha-3), `supply_demand_ratio` (float, renewable supply ÷ total withdrawal; values 0.31–6.12), `stress_class` (categorical: Extremely High / High / Medium-High / Medium / Low). Year: 2023 estimate.

### per_capita_freshwater
Fields: `country` (string), `per_capita_m3` (integer, cubic meters per person per year; range 84–80,620). Year: 2023 estimate. The 1,000 m³ threshold is commonly used to indicate water scarcity.

### groundwater_extraction
Fields: `country` (string), `extraction_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `recharge_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `extraction_recharge_ratio` (float; values 0.05–5.66). Ratio > 1.0 signals overdraft. Year: 2023 estimate.

### precipitation_trends
Fields: `country` (string), `decade` (categorical: 1990s / 2000s / 2010s), `mean_precip_mm` (integer, mm/year; range 41–1,761). Three decadal averages per country (30 rows total).

## Data Notes
- Supply-demand ratios are modeled estimates combining FAO AQUASTAT and WRI Aqueduct data.
- Groundwater recharge estimates carry ±15% uncertainty in arid regions.
- Precipitation values are country-wide spatial averages and mask sub-national variability.

# Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison

## Overview
Four datasets capture different dimensions of water stress for 10 countries spanning arid, semi-arid, and water-rich regions. Together they enable a composite view of regional water crisis severity.

## Data Source

### water_supply_demand
Fields: `country` (string), `iso` (ISO 3166 alpha-3), `supply_demand_ratio` (float, renewable supply ÷ total withdrawal; values 0.31–6.12), `stress_class` (categorical: Extremely High / High / Medium-High / Medium / Low). Year: 2023 estimate.

### per_capita_freshwater
Fields: `country` (string), `per_capita_m3` (integer, cubic meters per person per year; range 84–80,620). Year: 2023 estimate. The 1,000 m³ threshold is commonly used to indicate water scarcity.

### groundwater_extraction
Fields: `country` (string), `extraction_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `recharge_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `extraction_recharge_ratio` (float; values 0.05–5.66). Ratio > 1.0 signals overdraft. Year: 2023 estimate.

### precipitation_trends
Fields: `country` (string), `decade` (categorical: 1990s / 2000s / 2010s), `mean_precip_mm` (integer, mm/year; range 41–1,761). Three decadal averages per country (30 rows total).

## Data Notes
- Supply-demand ratios are modeled estimates combining FAO AQUASTAT and WRI Aqueduct data.
- Groundwater recharge estimates carry ±15% uncertainty in arid regions.
- Precipitation values are country-wide spatial averages and mask sub-national variability.
- Saudi Arabia's extremely high extraction-to-recharge ratio reflects reliance on non-renewable fossil aquifers.

    "South Africa": 0.98, "Mexico": 0.75, "Australia": 0.23,
    "United States": 0.88, "Brazil": 0.10, "Canada": 0.05

precip = {

    "Egypt":        {"1990s": 52,   "2000s": 47,   "2010s": 41},

    "Canada":       {"1990s": 537,  "2000s": 548,  "2010s": 562},

def precip_trend(c):

# Sort by supply/demand ratio ascending (most stressed first)

    "stress", ["#d73027", "#fc8d59", "#fee08b", "#91bfdb", "#4575b4"], N=256
)

def ratio_color(r, vmin=0.3, vmax=6.2):
    norm = Normalize(vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)
    return stress_cmap(norm(r))

style_ax(ax_bar)
ax_bar.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
vals = [supply_demand[c] for c in order]

bars = ax_bar.barh(order, vals, color=colors_bar, height=0.6, edgecolor="none")

ax_pc.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=7, framealpha=0.3,

ax_pc.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=False)

ax_gw.set_xlim(0, 6.8)
ax_gw.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=8.5)
ax_gw.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.3,

ax_gw.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_COL, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax_gw.grid(axis="y", visible=False)

ax_pc.set_xlabel("m³ / person / year  (log scale)", fontsize=8, color=TEXT_COL)
ax_pc.set_title("Per-Capita Freshwater\nAvailability  (2023)", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COL, pad=6)
ax_pc.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=7, framealpha=0.3,
             labelcolor=TEXT_COL, facecolor=PANEL_BG, edgecolor=GRID_COL)
ax_pc.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_COL, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax_pc.grid(axis="y", visible=False)
ax_pc.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=False)

# ── Panel 3: Groundwater extraction/recharge ratio ───────────────────────────
style_ax(ax_gw)
gw_vals = [gw_ratio[c] for c in order]
gw_colors = ["#d73027" if v > 1.0 else "#91bfdb" for v in gw_vals]
ax_gw.barh(order, gw_vals, color=gw_colors, height=0.6, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.9)
ax_gw.axvline(1.0, color="#f0a500", linewidth=1.8, linestyle="--",
              label="Extraction = Recharge  (ratio 1.0)")
ax_gw.set_xlabel("Extraction-to-Recharge Ratio", fontsize=9, color=TEXT_COL)
ax_gw.set_title("Groundwater Extraction vs. Recharge  (2023)", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COL, pad=6)
for i, (v, c) in enumerate(zip(gw_vals, order)):
    label = f"{v:.2f}×"
    ax_gw.text(v + 0.05, i, label, va="center", ha="left", fontsize=8,
               color="#d73027" if v > 1 else TEXT_COL, fontweight="bold" if v > 1 else "normal")
ax_gw.set_xlim(0, 6.8)
ax_gw.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=8.5)
ax_gw.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.3,
             labelcolor=TEXT_COL, facecolor=PANEL_BG, edgecolor=GRID_COL)
ax_gw.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_COL, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax_gw.grid(axis="y", visible=False)

# ── Panel 4: Precipitation trend (delta 1990s→2010s) ─────────────────────────
style_ax(ax_pr)
deltas = [precip_trend(c) for c in order]
trend_colors = ["#d73027" if d < 0 else "#4575b4" for d in deltas]
ax_pr.barh(order, deltas, color=trend_colors, height=0.6, edgecolor="none", alpha=0.9)
ax_pr.axvline(0, color=TEXT_COL, linewidth=1.0, linestyle="-", alpha=0.5)
ax_pr.set_xlabel("ΔPrecipitation  (mm/yr, 1990s→2010s)", fontsize=8, color=TEXT_COL)
ax_pr.set_title("Decadal Precipitation\nTrend  (1990s – 2010s)", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COL, pad=6)
for i, (d, c) in enumerate(zip(deltas, order)):
    ax_pr.text(d + (1 if d >= 0 else -1), i, f"{d:+d}", va="center",
               ha="left" if d >= 0 else "right", fontsize=8, color=TEXT_COL)
ax_pr.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=False)
ax_pr.grid(axis="x", color=GRID_COL, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax_pr.grid(axis="y", visible=False)

dec_patch = mpatches.Patch(color="#d73027", alpha=0.9, label="Declining")
inc_patch = mpatches.Patch(color="#4575b4", alpha=0.9, label="Increasing")
ax_pr.legend(handles=[dec_patch, inc_patch], loc="lower right", fontsize=7,
             framealpha=0.3, labelcolor=TEXT_COL, facecolor=PANEL_BG, edgecolor=GRID_COL)

# ── Panel 5: Composite heatmap ────────────────────────────────────────────────
style_ax(ax_heat)

def normalize_col(arr, invert=False):
    a = np.array(arr, dtype=float)
    mn, mx = a.min(), a.max()
    n = (a - mn) / (mx - mn)
    return 1 - n if invert else n

metrics = ["Supply/Demand\nRatio", "Per-Capita\nFreshwater", "GW Extraction/\nRecharge Ratio", "Precip\nTrend (1990→2010)"]

sd_norm   = normalize_col([supply_demand[c] for c in order], invert=False)   # higher = less stressed
pc_norm   = normalize_col([np.log10(per_capita[c]) for c in order], invert=False)
gw_norm   = normalize_col([gw_ratio[c] for c in order], invert=True)          # higher ratio = more stressed
pr_norm   = normalize_col([precip_trend(c) for c in order], invert=False)     # more negative = more stressed

# Stack: columns are metrics, rows are countries (order = most stressed first)
matrix = np.column_stack([sd_norm, pc_norm, gw_norm, pr_norm])

# Use a diverging red-blue colormap for "stress" (red=high stress)
heat_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    "heat_stress", ["#d73027", "#fc8d59", "#fee08b", "#91bfdb", "#4575b4"], N=256
)
im = ax_heat.imshow(matrix, aspect="auto", cmap=heat_cmap, vmin=0, vmax=1,
                    interpolation="nearest")

ax_heat.set_xticks(range(len(metrics)))
ax_heat.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=9, color=TEXT_COL)
ax_heat.set_yticks(range(len(order)))
ax_heat.set_yticklabels(order, fontsize=9, color=TEXT_COL)
ax_heat.set_title("Composite Water Stress Heatmap — All Indicators  (blue = water-secure, red = water-stressed)",
                  fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COL, pad=8)

for spine in ax_heat.spines.values():
    spine.set_edgecolor(GRID_COL)
ax_heat.tick_params(colors=TEXT_COL)
ax_heat.grid(False)

# Annotate cells with raw values
raw_vals = [
    [f"{supply_demand[c]:.2f}", f"{per_capita[c]:,}", f"{gw_ratio[c]:.2f}×",
     f"{precip_trend(c):+d} mm"] for c in order
]
for row_i, country in enumerate(order):
    for col_j in range(len(metrics)):
        val = raw_vals[row_i][col_j]
        cell_norm = matrix[row_i, col_j]
        txt_color = "white" if cell_norm < 0.55 else "#0e1117"
        ax_heat.text(col_j, row_i, val, ha="center", va="center",
                     fontsize=7.5, color=txt_color, fontweight="bold")

# Colorbar
cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax_heat, orientation="vertical", fraction=0.015, pad=0.02)
cbar.ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(color=TEXT_COL, labelsize=7)
cbar.set_ticks([0, 0.5, 1])
cbar.set_ticklabels(["Water\nStressed", "Moderate", "Water\nSecure"], color=TEXT_COL)
cbar.outline.set_edgecolor(GRID_COL)

# ── Main title & subtitle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.5, 0.955, "Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison",
         ha="center", va="top", fontsize=17, fontweight="bold", color=TEXT_COL)
fig.text(0.5, 0.932,
         "Ten countries assessed across four dimensions of water security  ·  2023 estimates  ·  Sources: FAO AQUASTAT, WRI Aqueduct",
         ha="center", va="top", fontsize=9, color="#8b949e")

plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
